area_weight: cos(latitude); include land and sea; no site coordinates
initialization_rule: target energy day D uses D-2 00UTC (32 hours before D-1 17KST deadline)
hourly_rule: energy hour ending t uses ceil(UTC lead/3)*3 interval mean; deaverage six-hour products as 2*mean6 - preceding_mean3 before aggregation; cloud clamp 0..100 and SW clamp >=0 for rounding
missing_policy: stop on missing grid/member/day; never use observed weather or shrink evaluation universe
